description: This file defines a deprecated PHP class 'FTPExtension' for FTP file transfer operations within Drupal, implementing connection management, file copying, directory creation/removal, and permission setting via FTP.

classes.name: FTPExtension
classes.description: A class for managing FTP file transfers using PHP's FTP extension, marked as deprecated in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the FTP extension class, triggers deprecation warning.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an FTP connection and logs in.

methods.name: copyFileJailed
methods.description: Copies a file to the FTP server.

methods.name: createDirectoryJailed
methods.description: Creates a directory on the FTP server.

methods.name: removeDirectoryJailed
methods.description: Removes a directory and its contents recursively.

methods.name: removeFileJailed
methods.description: Deletes a file from the FTP server.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a directory.

methods.name: isFile
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: chmodJailed
methods.description: Changes permissions of a file or directory, optionally recursively.
